cases.reviewerAnswer: No learner response is requested. The examples use the usual multiword spellings of compound numbers; permitted fused spellings also exist.
cases.element: content.body.steps[3].blocks[0].text: "Від 31 до 99, крім круглих десятків (40, 50…), — три слова з y"; content.body.steps[13].blocks[0].items[0]: "31–99, крім круглих десятків, — з y".
cases.defect: These statements present the usual spelling as obligatory. Standard Spanish also permits fused spellings with i, such as treintaicinco and cuarentaicinco.
cases.correction: Describe the separate spelling with y as the usual form taught in this course, without claiming that it is the only correct spelling.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Ortografía de la lengua española (2010), chapter VIII, discussion of compound cardinal numerals and permissible fused spellings from thirty onward (from memory).
cases.notes: The seven numbered teaching stages are interspersed with practice and summary steps; the larger number of step objects is not itself an inconsistency.
The article-free complement fits the isolated generic shopping quantity. A definite partitive expression would require a context identifying particular eggs.

cases.defect: For a literal half of a quantity, current Ukrainian orthography writes пів separately from the following genitive singular noun.
cases.correction: Replace the phrase with "Пів дюжини (6) яєць".
sources: Український правопис (2019), rule on separate spelling of the numeral пів with a following noun in the genitive singular when expressing half of something (from memory).
cases.notes: The Spanish answer and the explanation of media agreeing with docena are correct.

cases.reviewerAnswer: cuarenta y cinco; the permitted fused variant cuarentaicinco also fits.
cases.element: task.errors[0].feedbackUk: "Числа 31–99, крім круглих десятків, пишемо трьома словами"; task.hints[0].blocks[0].text and task.feedback.incorrectUk: "ставимо y і пишемо окремо".
cases.defect: The explanation makes separate spelling obligatory, although fused forms such as cuarentaicinco are also permitted. The reviewed error cuarentaycinco is indeed incorrect: the permissible fused form uses i.
cases.correction: Present the three-word form as the usual spelling, and retain the rejection of cuarentaycinco without implying that cuarentaicinco is incorrect.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Ortografía de la lengua española (2010), chapter VIII, discussion of compound cardinal numerals and permissible fused spellings with i (from memory).
cases.notes: No closed key is specified, so omission of cuarentaicinco from accepted does not by itself establish that the system rejects it.

cases.reviewerAnswer: En el museo hay doscientas fotos y treinta y cinco mapas. The variant with treintaicinco also fits.
cases.element: task.slots[1].errors[0].feedbackUk: "Числа 31–99, крім круглих десятків, пишемо трьома словами"; task.hints[0].blocks[0].text and task.feedback.incorrectUk: "ставимо y і пишемо окремо".
cases.defect: The explanation incorrectly treats multiword spelling as mandatory. Treintaicinco is permitted, although the explicitly reviewed spelling treintaycinco is incorrect.
cases.correction: Describe treinta y cinco as the usual spelling. Explain that treintaycinco is malformed without excluding the permitted fused form treintaicinco.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Ortografía de la lengua española (2010), chapter VIII, discussion of compound cardinal numerals and permissible fused spellings with i (from memory).
cases.notes: Both slots are open, so the absent fused variant is not demonstrably graded incorrect. Doscientas correctly agrees with fotos.
